title: Ruby News — APM (HTTP · DB · Logs · Jobs)
description: OpenTelemetry APM for the ruby-news service. Built from SigNoz official APM panels (traces) plus logs/jobs panels. All panels are hardcoded to serviceName = 'ruby-news' and require no span-metrics pipeline.

filter.expression: (serviceName = 'ruby-news' AND httpMethod EXISTS AND spanKind = 'Server') httpRoute EXISTS AND httpMethod EXISTS
(serviceName = 'ruby-news' AND httpMethod EXISTS AND spanKind = 'Server') httpRoute EXISTS AND httpMethod EXISTS
(spanKind = 'Server' AND httpMethod EXISTS AND serviceName = 'ruby-news') httpRoute EXISTS AND httpMethod EXISTS
(httpMethod EXISTS AND serviceName = 'ruby-news' AND spanKind = 'Server') responseStatusCode EXISTS AND httpRoute EXISTS
serviceName = 'ruby-news' externalHttpUrl EXISTS AND externalHttpMethod EXISTS
serviceName = 'ruby-news' externalHttpUrl EXISTS AND externalHttpMethod EXISTS
serviceName = 'ruby-news' externalHttpUrl EXISTS AND externalHttpMethod EXISTS

widgets.description: Rate of HTTP 5xx server errors per endpoint

filter.expression: serviceName = 'ruby-news' AND spanKind = 'Server' AND httpRoute EXISTS AND responseStatusCode LIKE '5%'

widgets.title: 5xx Error Rate by Endpoint

filter.expression: (dbSystem EXISTS AND serviceName = 'ruby-news') dbName EXISTS AND db.statement EXISTS
(dbSystem EXISTS AND serviceName = 'ruby-news') dbName EXISTS AND db.statement EXISTS
(dbSystem EXISTS AND serviceName = 'ruby-news') dbName EXISTS AND db.statement EXISTS
(dbSystem EXISTS AND serviceName = 'ruby-news' AND hasError = 'true') dbName EXISTS
